description: Réseau des routes à grande circulation de la Corrèze is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by legifrance.gouv.fr. NRGCCL019 Assembling the sections from the Topo BD of the IGN to form the network of high-traffic roads according to Decree No 2010-578 of 31 May 2010 amending Decree No 2009-615 of 3 June 2009 establishing the list of high-traffic roads. The highways defined in Article L. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Corrèze’s high-traffic roads network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2017-02-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
